adoration.text: Adoration Room: weekdays 07:00–22:00; weekends 07:00–20:00; public holidays 09:00–17:00; closed Mondays 09:00–14:00 (first Mondays 09:00–16:00 for cleaning).

confession.text: Confession is at L2 Confessionals 30 minutes before all weekend Eucharistic Celebrations when a priest is available.

devotions.text: Divine Mercy Devotion every Thursday 20:00 at L3 Auditorium.
Holy Hour with Reparation every 1st Thursday 20:00 at Church Hall.
Holy Hour with Reparation every 1st Friday 20:00 at Church Hall.
Eucharistic Healing Session every Tuesday 20:00 at Adoration Room.
Intercessory Prayer Monday, Wednesday and Friday 15:00 at St Thérèse L3 Room 3.4.
Chinese Prayer Group every Friday 20:00 at L4 Room 4.2.
